metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: CVE-2026-8452 — NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Exploitation
properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-8452: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service. . Product: NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-8452" or Message contains "NETSCALER ADC AND NETSCALER GATEWAY" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
